behavior: AC1: the push gate runs PR-Agent only at 3 or more new non-merge commits since the review PR-Agent would pick, skips bot pushes, and runs when there is no previous review or the input is unreadable
AC2: the workflow runs the gate only on synchronize, skips PR-Agent and the guard on run=false, and pushes run exactly /review -i
AC3: the registry declares the incremental Guide heading and the guard accepts every declared marker
AC4: ADR-040 records the decision and pr-stewardship names the draft practice
